description: Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules — WSTG 04-09 Authentication Error Detection

rules.name: Authentication — Brute Force Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects high volume of failed authentication attempts from a single source IP indicating brute force attack
rules.query:
let threshold = 10;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID in (4625)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Stuffing Attack
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing attempts using leaked username/password pairs across multiple accounts
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID in (4625)
| summarize distinct_count(TargetUserName), count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where distinct_count_TargetUserName > threshold and count_ > threshold * 3

rules.name: Authentication — Password Spraying Detection
rules.description: Detects password spraying where a single password is tried against many accounts
rules.query:
let threshold = 8;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where EventID in (4625)
| summarize distinct_count(TargetUserName), count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where distinct_count_TargetUserName > threshold

rules.name: Authentication — Account Lockout Storm
rules.description: Detects mass account lockouts indicating potential denial-of-service via authentication flooding
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID in (4740)
| summarize count(), distinct_count(TargetUserName) by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where distinct_count_TargetUserName > threshold

rules.name: Authentication — Impossible Travel Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins from geographically distant locations within impossible timeframes
rules.query:
let max_kmh = 800;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Location=parse_json(LocationDetails).countryOrRegion, Latitude=parse_json(LocationDetails).latitude, Longitude=parse_json(LocationDetails).longitude
| sort by UserPrincipalName, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize prev_lat = prev(Latitude), prev_lon = prev(Longitude), prev_time = prev(TimeGenerated), prev_user = prev(UserPrincipalName)
| where UserPrincipalName == prev_user and abs(Latitude - prev_lat) + abs(Longitude - prev_lon) > 30

rules.name: Authentication — Failed Login Then Success (Password Compromise)
rules.description: Detects failed login followed by success from same source indicating potential password compromise
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where EventID in (4625, 4624)
| summarize FailureCount=countif(EventID==4625), SuccessCount=countif(EventID==4624) by SourceIP, TargetUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where FailureCount > 3 and SuccessCount > 0

rules.name: Authentication — Default Credential Usage
rules.description: Detects login attempts using known default credentials on systems or devices
rules.query:
let default_users = dynamic(["admin", "root", "administrator", "guest", "default", "user", "test"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where EventID in (4624, 4625)
| where TargetUserName in (default_users)
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Kerberoasting Attack
rules.description: Detects Kerberos TGS ticket requests consistent with Kerberoasting attacks
rules.query:
let threshold = 10;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4769
| where ServiceName !startswith "krbtgt"
| summarize count() by ClientUserName, ServiceName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: Authentication — Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM authentication patterns consistent with pass-the-hash attacks
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| where LogonType == 3
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, WorkstationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3 and WorkstationName !startswith TargetUserName

rules.name: Authentication — Pass-the-Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse patterns consistent with pass-the-ticket attacks
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "Kerberos"
| where LogonType in (2, 3, 8)
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Golden Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects forged Kerberos TGT tickets consistent with Golden Ticket attacks
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4768
| where Status == "0x0"
| extend TicketLifetime = parse_json(TicketEncryptionType)
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| join kind=inner (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4769 | where Status == "0x0" | summarize count() by ClientUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)) on $left.TargetUserName == $right.ClientUserName

rules.name: Authentication — Silver Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects forged Kerberos TGS tickets consistent with Silver Ticket attacks
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4769
| where Status == "0x0"
| where ServiceName !startswith "krbtgt"
| where EncryptionType == "0x1"
| summarize count() by ClientUserName, ServiceName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — AS-REP Roasting
rules.description: Detects AS-REP roasting attacks targeting accounts with pre-authentication disabled
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID == 4768
| where Status in ("0x6", "0x7", "0x8", "0x9", "0xA", "0xB", "0xD", "0xE")
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning
rules.description: Detects LLMNR or NBT-NS name resolution poisoning attempts for credential relay attacks
rules.query:
let threshold = 10;
NetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where Protocol in ("LLMNR", "NBNS")
| where EventType == "NameResolution"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Dumping via LSASS
rules.description: Detects process access to LSASS memory indicative of credential dumping
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4663
| where ObjectName contains "lsass.exe"
| where ProcessName !in ("csrss.exe", "wininit.exe", "taskhostw.exe", "svchost.exe")
| summarize count() by ProcessName, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — SAM Database Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to the SAM database for credential extraction
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4663
| where ObjectName contains "SAM"
| where ProcessName !in ("lsass.exe", "wininit.exe", "svchost.exe")
| summarize count() by ProcessName, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — NTDS.DIT Extraction
rules.description: Detects access to NTDS.DIT Active Directory database for credential harvesting
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4663
| where ObjectName contains "ntds.dit"
| summarize count() by ProcessName, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — DCSync Attack
rules.description: Detects DCSync replication requests used to extract domain credentials
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4662
| where Properties contains "Replicating Directory Changes"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize count() by SubjectUserName, ObjectName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — MFA Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects authentication flows that bypass multi-factor authentication controls
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AuthenticationDetails has "MFA" and AuthenticationDetails !contains "MFA completed"
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — OAuth Token Abuse
rules.description: Detects suspicious OAuth token usage patterns indicating token theft or abuse
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has "OAuth"
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 20

rules.name: Authentication — Privileged Account Anomalous Login
rules.description: Detects anomalous login patterns for privileged accounts outside normal hours or locations
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName contains "Azure"
| where UserPrincipalName in ("admin@", "root@") or UserPrincipalName endswith "-admin@"
| where hod(TimeGenerated) !between (6 .. 20)
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, Location, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

rules.name: Authentication — Session Token Replay
rules.description: Detects session token reuse from different source IPs indicating token replay attacks
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ResultType == 0
| where CorrelationId != ""
| summarize dcount(IpAddress), count() by CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where dcount_IpAddress > 2 and count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — LDAP Simple Bind
rules.description: Detects LDAP simple bind operations that transmit credentials in cleartext
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID == 2889
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — SQL Injection Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in authentication forms that bypass login controls
rules.query:
let sqli_patterns = dynamic(["' OR 1=1", "' OR '", "admin'--", "1; DROP", "UNION SELECT", "' UNION", "1=1", "OR TRUE"]);
WAFLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where RequestQuery has_any (sqli_patterns) or RequestBody has_any (sqli_patterns)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — JWT Token Manipulation
rules.description: Detects JWT token manipulation attempts including algorithm confusion and signature bypass
rules.query:
AppGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where RequestHeaders has_any ("alg.none", "alg.None", "algorithm:none") or RequestBody has_any ("alg.none", "alg.None", "algorithm:none") or RequestHeaders contains "alg\":\"none" or RequestHeaders contains "alg\":\"None"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — SAML Token Forging
rules.description: Detects SAML token forging attempts and XML signature wrapping attacks
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where ResultType in (50053, 50074, 50076)
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "SAML"
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Relaying via NTLM
rules.description: Detects NTLM relay attacks forwarding authentication to downstream servers
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| where LogonType == 3
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize dcount(TargetServerName), count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where dcount_TargetServerName > 3

rules.name: Authentication — DNS-Based Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects DNS manipulation used to bypass authentication or redirect traffic
rules.query:
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where QueryType in ("A", "AAAA", "CNAME")
| where Name has_any ("login", "auth", "sso", "vpn", "owa")
| summarize dcount(IPAddresses), count() by ClientIP, Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where dcount_IPAddresses > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Weak Password Detection
rules.description: Detects accounts authenticating with weak passwords found in known breach databases
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AuthenticationDetails has "Password"
| join kind=inner (IdentityInfo
| where IsPasswordExpired == true or PasswordLastChange < ago(365d)) on UserPrincipalName
| project UserPrincipalName, LastPasswordChange=PasswordLastChange

rules.name: Authentication — Admin Account Enumeration
rules.description: Detects attempts to enumerate admin or privileged accounts via LDAP or directory queries
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID in (4662, 5136)
| where Properties has_any ("admin", "Admin", "Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins")
| summarize count() by SubjectUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Service Account Abuse
rules.description: Detects service accounts used for interactive logins or unusual access patterns
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where TargetUserName endswith "$"
| where LogonType in (2, 10, 7)
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, WorkstationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — Certificate-based Auth Fraud
rules.description: Detects fraudulent certificate-based authentication including stolen or forged certificates
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "X509"
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has_any ("certificate", "smartcard")
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — PTH Over WinRM
rules.description: Detects pass-the-hash attack patterns over WinRM connections
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| where LogonType == 3
| where ProcessName has "winrm"
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — Forged PAC Attack
rules.description: Detects privilege attribute certificate manipulation in Kerberos tickets
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4769
| where Status == "0x0"
| where Properties has_any ("PAC", "Privilege", "forged")
| summarize count() by ClientUserName, ServiceName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Authentication — Downgrade Attack on Auth Protocol
rules.description: Detects authentication protocol downgrade from Kerberos to NTLM indicating potential downgrade attacks
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| join kind=inner (SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "Kerberos"
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize count() by TargetUserName) on TargetUserName
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Idle Session Hijacking
rules.description: Detects session hijacking of idle authenticated sessions
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where SessionLifetime > 8h
| where TimeSinceLastActivity > 30m
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Broken Authentication Session Management
rules.description: Detects broken authentication session management including session fixation and insecure cookie flags
rules.query:
AppGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where RequestMethod == "POST"
| where RequestUri has_any ("login", "auth", "session")
| where ResponseCode in (200, 302)
| where ResponseHeaders !contains "Secure" or ResponseHeaders !contains "HttpOnly"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Cross-Site Request Forgery on Auth
rules.description: Detects CSRF attacks targeting authentication endpoints
rules.query:
WAFLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where RequestMethod == "POST"
| where RequestUri has_any ("login", "password", "auth", "changepwd")
| where RequestHeaders !contains "X-CSRF" and RequestHeaders !contains "X-Requested-With"
| where Referer !contains parse_url(RequestUri).host
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Insecure Password Reset
rules.description: Detects abuse of insecure password reset mechanisms including predictable tokens
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ResultType in (50055, 50056, 50057)
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has_any ("password-reset", "forgot-password")
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Concurrent Session Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous concurrent sessions from multiple locations for the same user
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize dcount(IpAddress), dcount(Location), count() by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where dcount_IpAddress > 3 and dcount_Location > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Expired Credential Usage
rules.description: Detects authentication attempts with expired credentials suggesting credential reuse or theft
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ResultType == 50055
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — RDP Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks targeting Remote Desktop Protocol authentication
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 4625
| where LogonType == 10 or LogonType == 7
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "Negotiate"
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — SSH Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks targeting SSH authentication on Linux systems
rules.query:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where Facility == "auth"
| where SyslogMessage contains "Failed password"
| summarize count() by extract(@"from ([0-9.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Account Manipulation
rules.description: Detects account manipulation including privilege escalation, group modification, and attribute changes
rules.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where EventID in (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4728, 4729, 4730, 4731, 4732, 4733, 4734, 4735, 4737, 4738, 4740, 4741, 4742, 4743, 4754, 4755, 4756, 4757, 4758, 4764)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize count() by EventID, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — Conditional Access Policy Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass conditional access policies through legacy protocols or exemption abuse
rules.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ResultType == 0
| where ConditionalAccessPolicies has "notApplied" or ConditionalAccessPolicies has "reportOnlyMode"
| where ClientAppUsed in ("Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP", "POP3", "SMTP")
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where count_ > 5
